name: Hotel Terme di Saturnia
insider_take: Ancient Romans discovered these magical thermal springs over 2,000 years ago, and today's guests still experience the same naturally healing waters at a perfectly constant 37°C year-round.
whats_special: The hotel sits atop natural sulfur springs that create the famous cascading limestone pools of Cascate del Mulino - one of Italy's most photographed natural wonders. These therapeutic waters contain sulfur, calcium, and magnesium, believed to have anti-inflammatory and skin-rejuvenating properties. The property is also a golf destination, featuring an 18-hole championship course designed by Ronald Fream with panoramic views of the Maremma countryside.
pro_tip: Visit the free public thermal pools at Cascate del Mulino just 5 minutes away for a magical sunrise or sunset experience, but book spa treatments at the hotel during midday when the public pools are most crowded.
dont_miss: The nearby medieval hilltop town of Pitigliano, known as "Little Jerusalem" for its historic Jewish quarter carved into volcanic rock cliffs. Also explore Sovana's Etruscan tombs and the UNESCO World Heritage site of Val d'Orcia, just an hour's drive through Tuscany's most scenic wine country.
pros: Natural thermal springs with therapeutic healing properties
Luxury spa treatments and wellness facilities
Stunning Tuscan countryside setting with scenic views
Fine dining restaurant featuring local Maremma cuisine
cons: Remote location requires car for exploring nearby attractions
Premium pricing reflects luxury spa resort positioning
